preview.text: Zimbabwe Women face West Indies Women in a T20 match at Takashinga Sports Club after winning the toss and choosing to bat first. The usual first-innings score in the 6 recorded T20 matches at Takashinga Sports Club is 122. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 49 per cent chance of rain, about 26 degrees.

summary.text: West Indies Women won by 8 wkts. ZIMW made 142-6, Kelis Ndhlovu top-scoring with 65 off 48 balls; Stafanie Taylor took 2 for 8. WIW made 119-2, Stafanie Taylor top-scoring with 52 off 35 balls; Christine Mutasa took 1 for 19. Sides batting first at Takashinga Sports Club usually make about 122.
